about: a TXT record carries instructions to send the records elsewhere

reads.note: uProc's process endpoint (n8n's uProc node POSTs {processor: get-domain-records, params: {domain}} with the template's leading space kept in the domain); the result is under message, as the template family reads it (shape assumed: uProc's API docs are no longer published)
